sources.title: [Incubation] llm-d Semantic Classifier (llm-d-sc) #2193
sources.snippet: Proposal: llm-d-sc (llm-d Semantic Classifier) as an incubation project Summary llm-d-sc will be plug-and-play classifier runtime for inference request routing. It hosts small classifier models, serves them over HTTP and gRPC, and returns calibrated, versioned classification signals that a router or scheduler can use to select a model.

sources.title: llm-d
sources.snippet: llm-d is an open-source, Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It runs vLLM, SGLang, and more across your cluster, turning single-node engines into production-grade serving on the hardware you already have.
